description: Generic Sega Genesis / Mega Drive game profile (3-button pad). A is the leftmost face button, B middle, C right. RetroPad convention treats C as the primary 'A-equivalent' so confirm binds to face_east.

confirm.hint: Press C. Primary action in most Genesis games (jump in Sonic, attack in Streets of Rage), advance menus.

cancel.hint: Press B. Secondary action (special move in Streets of Rage, spin-dash in Sonic 2+), cancel menus.

special.hint: Press A. Tertiary action: weapon cycle, sub-attack, defensive move.

menu.hint: Press Start. Open the pause menu, start the game from the title screen.

nav_up.hint: Walk / move up. In menus: cursor up.

nav_down.hint: Walk / move down. In menus: cursor down.

nav_left.hint: Walk / move left. In menus: cursor left.

nav_right.hint: Walk / move right. In menus: cursor right.

notes: 3-button pad only — the 6-button Genesis controller's X/Y/Z buttons are not covered by this profile. A 6-button variant would extend with face_north + shoulder slots.
